record.description: A two-level window perch that suction-mounts to glass so cats can rest high up and watch the view and sunshine. The metal frame is sturdy, the plush mattress comes off for machine washing, and the adjustable height gives cats of different sizes room to climb. Suits small spaces.
A women's slipper from Merrell in black, sized 5.0 M US. It features a Select GRIP outsole designed to provide durable traction on surfaces where grip is needed.

specs.care: Machine washable, cold water, gentle cycle, tumble dry low

record.description: A long buffalo plaid table runner in black and white with a farmhouse look. Made from a cotton and polyester blend, it is machine washable and resists shrinking and fading. Suits dining tables, banquet tables, mantels, and buffets for holidays, parties, weddings, and everyday meals.

specs.package dimensions: 2.8 L x 4.8 W x 13 H cm

record.description: A black case designed to hold a Harley Tec X linerlock knife. Compact at roughly 13 cm tall, it is a lightweight accessory for carrying and protecting the blade when not in use.

specs.extras: Built-in water bottle holder and phone/accessory holder

record.description: An indoor stationary exercise bike for home cardio workouts. Its 30-pound flywheel provides manually adjustable resistance, and the padded seat and aero handlebars both adjust to fit different body sizes. Includes a water bottle holder and a phone or accessory holder.

specs.care: Water resistant, easy to clean

record.description: A lightweight camouflage backpack designed for elementary school children. It offers several compartments, including a laptop sleeve and a small zippered pouch, plus mesh side pockets that fit a water bottle. Padded adjustable straps and a top handle make it easy to carry.

specs.care: Machine washable in cold water, tumble dry low

record.description: Airy linen-blend curtain panels with an open weave and soft touch. They let in diffused daylight while offering privacy and a relaxed, natural look. Each panel has nickel grommets for simple hanging, and the set suits living rooms and bedrooms alike.

A nail polish from the Sally Hansen Xtreme Wear line, offering a long-wearing, hard-finish formula with rich color and shine. Part of the brand's current on-trend shade collection, in a 0.4 fluid ounce bottle.

specs.care: Wipe with damp cloth, towel dry

record.description: A black countertop mug tree that holds six mugs or teacups by their handles, with upward-curving branches to keep them steady. Its looped top makes it easy to carry, and the vertical design frees up counter and cabinet space for a tidy coffee station.

A men's Carhartt jacket from the Full Swing Cryder line, finished in Shadow and sized Medium. It is treated to repel light rain and includes stretch fabric for easier movement, a back panel that allows range of motion, and flexible elbows for less restriction.

A tall, foldable laundry hamper with two removable bags so dirty clothes can be carried out without a trip to the basket. The durable Oxford fabric is supported by fiber rods to stay upright, and the frame folds flat for travel, dorms, or small apartments.

A collectible Echidna figure from the Re:Zero anime series, sculpted in her Mandarin dress version. It comes with a base stand for display. This official licensed prize figure is made by Taito and suits fans of the series.

specs.fit: Drop tail with adjustable drawcord hem

record.description: A women's black down jacket from Columbia, insulated with 700 fill power goose down and built with a waterproof, breathable, fully seam-sealed shell. It has a removable, helmet-compatible hood, stretch fabric for movement, underarm venting, a zippered waist pocket, and adjustable cuffs.

Anti-slip ankle socks for babies and toddlers, with rubber dotted grips on the sole to help little ones walk, crawl, or play on slides safely. Made of medium-thickness combed cotton that is breathable and stretchy, with a soft heel tab and a loose ankle cuff for comfort. Sold in a value pack with a range of colors.

Unframed canvas print reproducing Edward Hopper's painting People in the Sun, printed in high definition with vivid colors. Suited to living rooms, bedrooms, offices, and cafes, it works as wall art or a gift for art lovers.

specs.care: Wrinkle free

record.description: A grey men's dress shirt in solid poplin, cut to a fitted silhouette with a tapered waist and roomier shoulders and chest. Its wrinkle-free finish keeps it easy to care for. Features a classic point collar that works with or without a tie, an adjustable two-button cuff, and a chest pocket.

A classic red wagon with an all-steel seamless body and rugged 10-inch rubber tires for a smooth ride. The extra-long pull handle folds under for storage, and the controlled turning radius helps prevent tipping. Suited to hauling toddlers, garden soil, plants, or everyday gear.

specs.strap style: Back adjustable, convertible traditional or crisscross

record.description: A wirefree everyday bra offering full coverage and comfortable support. Lightly lined cups give a smooth, modest shape, and the silky fabric lies sleek under clothing. Back straps convert between traditional and crisscross styles for versatile wear.

specs.material: Wheat straw fiber and food-grade PP

record.description: A set of four 24 oz cereal bowls made from wheat straw fiber and food-grade PP plastic. The bowls are lightweight, unbreakable, and free of BPA. Deep sides help keep food from splashing, making them suitable for cereal, salad, fruit, rice, and noodles. They can be washed in the dishwasher and heated in the microwave.

specs.use: Cake decoration and photo booth prop

record.description: A dark blue cake topper showing the number one, made for a baby boy's first birthday. It arrives pre-assembled, so it can be placed directly on a cake. Its sparkly glitter paper adds a festive touch, and it also works as a prop for cake smash photos.

Maintenance-free flanged sleeve bearing made from SAE 841 sintered bronze, which is mostly copper. It resists wear and corrosion and suits general-purpose uses with moderate speeds and loads. Dimensions are 12 mm bore, 15 mm outer diameter, and 12 mm length, with an 18 mm flange.

specs.media_handling: Sheet feed, roll feed, input tray, automatic cutter

record.description: A compact wireless large-format plotter designed for architects, engineers, and builders working in home or small offices. It prints sheets and rolls up to 24 inches wide, includes an automatic cutter, and supports printing from mobile devices through apps.

A five-pack of sleeveless white bodysuits for babies sized 6 to 12 months. The soft, flexible fabric stretches in four directions to move with your baby, and expandable shoulders make dressing easier. Reinforced snaps are designed to hold up to repeated washing and wear.

A set of three stainless steel mixing bowls in 1.5, 3, and 5-quart sizes for whisking, mixing, marinating, and serving. The lightweight commercial-grade bowls stack for compact storage and can go in the dishwasher, refrigerator, and freezer.

specs.care: Machine or hand washable

record.description: A summer short dress with a flattering V neckline, butterfly short sleeves, and an A-line high-waisted silhouette. Its all-over print adds easy style for casual or everyday wear. The fabric has no stretch, so check the size chart before ordering.

A green cactus-patterned neck lanyard with a card holder for two ID cards. Made of soft polyester with double-sided printing and a metal clasp for keys, it suits work badges and makes a cheerful gift.

specs.design: Halloween letter print with Sanderson Sisters graphic

record.description: A loose-fitting short-sleeve Halloween tee with a playful letter print and Sanderson Sisters graphic. Made from a soft, stretchy, breathable cotton blend, it pairs easily with jeans, leggings, or boots for cooler seasons.

specs.card slots: 9 credit card slots plus 1 photo slot

record.description: A slim bi-fold women's wallet in pink genuine cowhide leather with an embossed checkered texture. It holds multiple cards, a photo, a coin pocket, and bills, and includes a zip pocket. The RFID-blocking lining helps guard card data from unauthorized wireless scans.

Roll-up storage bags for packing clothing and linens while traveling. Roll out the air to compact contents without a vacuum. Protects items from bugs, moths, dirt, mildew, and odors. Suited to coats, laundry, and soiled items.

A moderate-mileage running shoe built for comfort and durability. Gel cushioning in the rear and forefoot softens impact, and a high-wear outsole protects the areas that take the most punishment. The removable sockliner makes room for a medical orthotic.

specs.assembly: Easy to assemble, all hardware included

record.description: A white three-cube storage organizer with an open back and a sturdy frame. It can be set up vertically or horizontally and is sized to hold 13-inch fabric storage bins. Finished on the front and back, it arrives with all hardware for simple assembly.

A vintage-style women's handbag in solid brown with a shiny patent finish. It has a top handle, a detachable chain strap for shoulder or crossbody wear, and a flap closure with a magnetic snap and zipper. The interior is lined with soft polyester and fits a phone, wallet, sunglasses, and makeup case.

specs.features: Wireless charging compatible, precise cutouts

record.description: A slim protective case built for the iPhone XR, with a matte PC back and flexible TPU sides that absorb drops and bumps. Its raised front edge helps guard the screen, and openings give easy access to buttons and ports without removing the case. Supports wireless charging.

specs.style: Short sleeve bodysuit with lap shoulder

record.description: A black short-sleeve infant bodysuit featuring a retro 90s sitcom quote print. Made from soft, pre-shrunk ring-spun cotton with a snap crotch for easy changes. Printed in the USA, it suits baby showers, birthdays, and holiday gifts.
A women's western cowboy boot from Ariat in the Dahlia style, featuring a brown floral pattern. It has a Duratread outsole for durable wear. Available in US women's size 11 medium.

Automatic electric running boards for select Nissan Titan and Titan XD trucks. They extend when the door opens and retract out of sight when it closes. Built from die-cast aluminum with a corrosion-resistant coated finish, with an integrated LED light and pinch-proof sensing.

A slim 18-inch sterling silver box chain with a lobster claw clasp. Its rhodium plating helps the chain keep a bright, polished shine. Lightweight and fairly sturdy, it suits everyday wear with many outfits. Not for use during exercise, bathing, or sleep.
A large green shark-shaped pencil eraser designed for correcting big mistakes. Suited to school, homework, and office use, it also makes a playful back-to-school gift.

A short-sleeved midi dress in a navy striped pattern, with a stretch polyester fabric that follows a curvy sheath shape. Features a round neckline, cap sleeves, and a concealed back zipper. Sizing runs slightly small, so consider ordering one size up when between sizes.

A replacement chrome aerator from Delta rated at 2.2 gallons per minute. It threads onto Delta Neo Style lavatory faucets with a 55/64 inch by 27 female thread, helping control water flow at the sink.

specs.care: Machine washable and dryable

record.description: A lightweight button-up shirt for men, made from a linen and cotton blend that breathes well for warm weather. Its narrow collar and rolled sleeves suit both business casual and weekend outings. Tailored slimmer through the chest and torso with a fitted shoulder, it can go straight into the washer and dryer.

specs.fit: Close to the body, fitted slim silhouette

record.description: A men's lightweight T-shirt with a textured slub jersey cotton feel and a close, slim fit. It features a V-neckline and a chest pocket. Offered in a pampas yellow shade in a large size.

A black rubber runner with a textured cleat surface to reduce slipping on damp floors. Suited to ramps, walkways, entryways, and high-traffic commercial areas, and it helps protect subfloors. Lightweight and easy to move and install.

specs.care: Machine wash cold, gentle cycle, tumble dry low

record.description: A white cotton throw with a classic diamond pattern and decorative fringe edges. Its vintage-inspired look suits rustic or distressed decor. Drape it over a couch or chair for warmth and color, or use it for picnics, camping, or wrapping gifts.

specs.care: Hand wash with mild detergent

record.description: A heavyweight aluminum pan designed for baking classic angel food cakes. Its metal conducts heat gently and evenly for consistent baking, and the nonstick coating helps cakes release easily and clean up with less effort. Hand washing with mild detergent is recommended.

specs.construction: Hard plastic back with flexible silicone bumper

record.description: A slim, transparent protective case for the iPhone 11 Pro Max that keeps the phone's original look visible. Its hard plastic back and soft silicone bumper add shock protection, with reinforced corners and raised edges around the camera and screen. Designed to work with most wireless chargers.

specs.outsole: Direct injected one-component PU with shock point

record.description: Men's black oxford shoe from ECCO with a bike-toe profile and blind-eyelet lacing. Double-stitched seams and a moisture-wicking lining help keep feet dry, while the ventilation system supports airflow. A direct-injected PU outsole adds cushioning underfoot.

specs.included: Extension kits, pressure mount rods, wall cups, mounting kit

record.description: A steel pressure-mounted safety gate with a walk-through door for doorways, hallways, and the bottom of stairs. It adjusts to openings of roughly 29 to 47 inches and stands 30 inches tall. Includes extension kits, wall cups, and mounting hardware. Suited to children about 6 to 24 months old, and it wipes clean.

A men's low-cut soccer shoe built for artificial turf play. Features a regular fit and a Demonscale 3D-printed strike zone to help control the ball. Available in core black, white and active red colorway in size 11.5.

specs.included: 3 x 5 ft ropes, stainless steel D-rings

record.description: A triangular sand-colored shade sail made from new high-density polyethylene that blocks up to 95% of UV rays. Its breathable fabric lets air and water pass through. Suited to patios, pools, lawns and gardens, it comes with ropes and stainless steel D-rings for mounting.

specs.care: Hand wash cold, do not bleach, hang dry

record.description: High-waisted flare palazzo wide leg pants in a soft peachskin blend of polyester and spandex. The higher waistband is designed to sit comfortably and stay in place, with a flowing leg for a relaxed silhouette. Available in printed and solid styles, in regular and plus sizes.

specs.care: Machine wash cold, gentle cycle; sun-dry or tumble dry low

record.description: A reversible queen comforter set in grey, with two pillow shams included. The brushed microfiber shell is soft, and the polyester fill is light yet warm enough for every season. Machine washable in cold water on a gentle cycle. Made without down, so it suits allergy sufferers.

A lightweight LED headlamp with an 800-lumen CREE XM-L T6 bulb and three modes (high, low, strobe) plus zoom to adjust the beam. Its elastic, adjustable headband and tiltable head suit running, hiking, camping, fishing, and repairs. IP50 splash resistance, but do not submerge it.

A keto-friendly snack box holding five lemon vanilla protein wafer crisps. Each sweet vanilla-covered wafer has a lemon filling and delivers 11 grams of protein and 5 grams of fiber, making it a filling option for a low-carb lifestyle.

Women's mid rise bootcut jeans with flame-resistant construction rated to NFPA 70E, NFPA 2112, and CAT 2 standards. Cotton and Lycra blend offers stretch for comfortable all-day wear. Features an embroidered back pocket detail and an entwined pattern in a style suited to work or casual occasions.

specs.material: Wool-like plush fleece upper and lining
specs.care: Machine washable

record.description: Slip-on women's house slippers with a soft fleece lining and a wool-like plush upper. Memory foam insole provides cushioned comfort, while the rubber sole offers traction for indoor and outdoor use. Machine washable for easy care.

Relaxed-fit carpenter jeans in lightweight, garment-washed cotton duck. Five-pocket styling includes a utility pocket, coin pocket, and a hammer loop. Triple-stitched seams and brass rivets add durability, and the straight leg sits comfortably over boots.

specs.set contents: Women's engagement ring, women's band, men's band

record.description: A matching his-and-hers wedding and engagement ring set in polished stainless steel. The women's engagement ring features a round cubic zirconia center stone set in prongs, paired with a women's band, plus a comfort-fit men's band. Nickel-free and tarnish-resistant, and packaged in a gift box.

specs.compatibility: Binoculars without a threaded tripod socket

record.description: A universal mount that lets binoculars without a threaded tripod socket attach to a standard tripod. It uses a standard 1/4-inch-20 screw thread and fits a wide range of binocular models for steadier viewing.

specs.widths: Wide widths available in Black and Natural
specs.care: Machine wash and dry

record.description: A classic open-toe spa slipper with a soft terry upper and a flip-flop style that suits all-year wear. Its memory foam footbed cradles the arch and heel, while the anti-skid rubber sole gives secure footing indoors and out. Machine washable for easy care.

Moderate graduated compression socks for women, designed for all-day wear, travel, and long periods of sitting or standing. The four-zone compression aims to ease swelling and leg fatigue, and the yarns help manage moisture and odor. Features arch support and a turn welt top.

A loose-fitting women's tunic top with a printed design, a V-neck with collar detail, and 3/4 roll-tab sleeves that can be adjusted. The high-low hem drapes into a flared silhouette. Soft, lightweight, and stretchy, it pairs well with leggings, jeans, or pants.

A black luggage strap from Samsonite that cinches around bags to make them easier to spot on the carousel. Its polypropylene strap adjusts to fit bags up to 72 inches, and a rugged ABS buckle is designed to hold up to rough baggage handling. This version has no lock.

A classic Western-style ankle bootie with a V cutout at the front and a chunky stacked block heel. Lightweight with a lightly padded footbed and an inner zip for easy on and off. Vegan construction, suited to casual or dressy outfits.
A 69-piece sticker set featuring Futurama characters and themes. The PVC decals range from about 1 to 3 inches and suit laptops, skateboards, backpacks, luggage, bicycles and other surfaces.

specs.sizing note: Relaxed fit; order a size up

record.description: Strappy women's sandals from Crocs with a cushioned LiteRide foam insole that is soft, light, and resilient. Croslite foam outsoles provide all-day support, and the stretch gore upper feels comfortable from the first wear. The fit runs relaxed, so ordering a size up is suggested.

specs.paper: High quality paper stock from well-managed forests

record.description: A humorous Hallmark Shoebox birthday card for a friend or relative who enjoys irreverent, edgy jokes. It features modern lettering on a sunrise background and comes with a matching envelope.

specs.care: Machine washable (remove insole)

record.description: Comfortable women's flats with a knit upper, soft cotton lining, and a cushioned removable leather insole with arch support. The jelly outsole offers lightweight flexibility and slip resistance for everyday wear, driving, and walking. Machine washable after removing the insole.

A lightweight classic-fit graphic t-shirt featuring a Switzerland theme, suited to outdoor activities, travel, or as a souvenir or gift. Double-needle stitching on the sleeves and hem adds durability.

Foil-backed cotton pipe wrap for insulating, cushioning, and reducing vibration on heating and air conditioning ducts. Installs without gloves, face mask, or goggles. Carries a Class A fire rating and provides strong insulating power across a 25-foot roll.

An espresso and cappuccino machine with a brushed stainless-steel finish and red accents. It uses a 20 bar pump and a steam nozzle for frothing milk. The removable water tank and drip tray make refilling and cleaning simpler.

A 20-inch freestyle BMX bike built for tricks and street riding. It features a freestyle rotor, front and rear U-brakes, and front and rear pegs for stunt riding. The 48-spoke wheels and deluxe paint finish complete the design.

specs.material: High density fiberboard and solid wood veneer

record.description: A walnut-finish jewelry armoire with a locking top lid, a vanity mirror, and ring rolls. Side doors reveal double-tiered necklace hooks, and eight pull-out drawers organize smaller pieces. Arrives ready to use with no assembly needed.

specs.overall dimensions: 18 ft (L) x 17 ft (D) x 9.5 ft (H) inflated
specs.included: carry bag, repair kit, 5 stakes, 2 hoses

record.description: An inflatable water park with two slides, a climbing wall, a splash pool and a water cannon for children aged roughly 3 to 10. Its puncture-resistant PVC-coated fabric and safety netting support play indoors or outdoors. It inflates in minutes, folds into a compact bag, and the blower is sold separately.

A wired optical USB mouse with three buttons and a rubber scroll wheel for everyday office and study work. Its 1000 DPI sensor offers responsive, precise cursor control. It is plug and play, needing no drivers, and works with Windows and Mac computers. The 1.6-meter cord gives flexible placement.

A mid-calf winter boot from Sorel with waterproof suede uppers, a soft shearling cuff, and a faux fur lining for warmth. The vulcanized rubber shell and seam-sealed construction are built for rain and snow, and a bonded felt frost plug adds insulation underfoot.

Individual faux mink lash extensions for salon use, offering a CC curl and 0.25 mm thickness in an 8 mm length. The metallic film strip avoids the residue left by paper backing. Designed to shorten application time and keep a full, even look that lasts.

A two-pack of men's long sleeve athletic t-shirts in sport grey, medium size. The moisture-wicking fabric is designed to help keep the wearer cool. Features include a longer dropped shoulder, reinforced neck tape, and twist-resistant side seams after washing.

A minimizer underwire bra in a soft body beige tone. The smoothing fabric and two-ply back help shape and smooth the bust, while wider-set straps and a more open underwire provide comfortable support. The open neckline offers balanced coverage.

An incline wedge gymnastics mat for tumbling, stretching, yoga, and fitness training at home, school, or the gym. Its trapezoidal shape lets several mats stack for storage. Removable zippered inner liner makes the cover easy to clean.

specs.closure: bottom zipper and hook and loop wings

record.description: A swaddle wearable sack for newborns that can be worn with arms in, arms out, or one of each. A bottom zipper allows quick diaper changes without unwrapping the baby. Adjustable hook and loop wings give a snug, secure fit that helps limit startle reflex.

A small 14k white gold pendant charm shaped as the number 1, laser cut and etched with a satin texture and rhodium plating. Suited to necklaces as a personal keepsake for a milestone or everyday wear, and it arrives in gift packaging.

specs.features: UV scratch resistant coating, bevelled edges

record.description: A slim, clear protective case for iPhone X and XS that uses D3O impact material to guard against knocks and drops. Bevelled edges add extra protection, while a UV scratch-resistant coating helps keep the case looking clear. Precision cut-outs keep all buttons and ports easy to reach.

Warm winter ankle boots for women, made from vegan faux leather with a cozy lining and padded collar. Quilted side panels and a rubber sole offer stable footing on slippery surfaces, suited to fall and winter outdoor wear.

Classic black denim jeans with a slim-fit silhouette that tapers through the thigh and flares into a bootcut leg. Stretch in the fabric adds comfort and helps the jeans keep their shape for everyday wear.

specs.strap: Reversible nylon slip-thru, blue with white/yellow floral and swirl print
specs.features: Indiglo light-up dial, 24-hour military time

record.description: A women's Timex Weekender watch with a round white dial, Arabic numerals, and 24-hour military time. The reversible nylon slip-thru strap shows blue on one side and a white and yellow floral swirl print on the other. It has a 38mm polished silver-tone case and an Indiglo backlight, and is splash resistant to 30 meters but not suitable for swimming.

specs.other features: D-ring at left leg, adjustable ankle toggles

record.description: Women's scrub pants in black with a low-rise cargo cut. The drawstring waistband and multiple pockets, including a scissors pocket, keep essentials handy. A D-ring on the left leg and adjustable ankle toggles add practical touches for busy shifts.

A one-piece swimsuit for little girls, printed with a playful pattern. Its stretchy polyamide-elastane fabric is smooth against sensitive skin, dries fairly quickly, and allows free movement. Suited to pool, beach, and bath-time play, with moderate coverage for all-day wear. Hand wash in cool water and hang to dry.
A lightweight Marvel Spider-Man: Spider-Verse T-shirt featuring Miles Morales, officially licensed. It has a classic fit and double-needle stitching at the sleeves and hem for durability.

specs.washability: Washes out with shampoo and water
specs.use: Party, cosplay, DIY, dog hair coloring

record.description: A set of ten bright temporary hair chalks with built-in combs for quick, non-permanent color changes. Works best on light hair and can be blended. Washes out with ordinary shampoo, making it a fun gift for kids and teens for parties, cosplay, or holidays.

Women's no-show liners with a breathable mesh top and a cushioned, ventilated sole for comfort. A silicone heel grip helps keep them in place, and the soft construction feels gentle against the foot. Sold as a three-pair pack in black.

A 5.2-channel home theater receiver that handles 4K Ultra HD video with HDR and HLG support. It streams music over built-in Bluetooth from multiple devices and joins a multi-room system through HEOS Link. Four front-panel buttons store preferred audio settings, and an on-screen setup assistant guides installation.

A foldable vocal booth designed to reduce echo, reflections, and room coloration for cleaner voice and instrument recordings. Its interior is lined with dense egg crate foam, and it includes holes for audio cables and a mic stand. It folds flat for easy transport and works with most microphones and stands.

specs.material: 100% cotton canvas front, 100% polyester mesh back

record.description: A structured, medium-profile cap with a pre-curved sandwich visor and a Carhartt patch on the front. The washed cotton canvas front pairs with a breathable polyester mesh back, and the sweatband is designed to help control odor and wick moisture.

A compact laser projector from Epson that casts a bright image up to 150 inches, even in lit rooms. Built-in Android TV with voice search lets you reach popular streaming apps without extra hardware. An internal speaker provides audio, and a 3.5mm output connects external sound.

A retro tennis-style women's sneaker with a leather upper, traditional lace-up closure, and a contrasting Swoosh accent running from heel to midfoot. The solid rubber outsole has a herringbone pattern for traction, and the soft fabric lining sits over a comfort footbed.

specs.features: Detachable hand strap, elastic cable loops, mesh pockets

record.description: A compact black travel organizer for keeping cables, chargers, USB drives, memory cards and small devices in order. Its water-resistant nylon shell and two zippers give quick access, while elastic loops and mesh pockets hold items in place. A padded pocket fits a 7.9-inch mini tablet, and a detachable strap makes it easy to carry.

A women's tote from Under Armour with a highly water-resistant UA Storm finish to handle the elements. It offers a large main compartment, an oversized wordmark zipper pull, and double webbing straps for several carrying options. Holds about 25 liters when full.

A lightweight running shoe from Nike, updated from the Air Mariah design first released in the 1980s. It has a sock-like Flyknit upper, Zoom Air cushioning, a heel pull tab, and a durable rubber outsole.

specs.included: Hook & loop roll, push pins, instruction manual

record.description: A magnetic door screen made of thickened fiberglass mesh that lets fresh air and sunlight into a home while keeping insects out. Edges are reinforced with webbing and double-stitched, and hook-and-loop hasps at the middle and bottom help hold it in place in wind. Sized for doors up to 36 by 80 inches.

specs.material: Shag pile with sponge middle layer

record.description: A large shag area rug in teal blue with a deep, soft pile that feels plush underfoot. Its anti-slip dots help keep it in place on smooth floors, and the sponge layer adds some sound absorption. Suited to living rooms, bedrooms, and kids' rooms. Vacuum-packed, so allow a few days for it to relax and lose wrinkles.

specs.sleeve: Long sleeve with roll tab and button closure
specs.care: Machine or hand wash cold, do not bleach, hang or low-heat tumble dry

record.description: A long-sleeve henley-style popover shirt in plain blue with a mandarin collar and chest buttons. Its slightly thick cotton-poly oxford blend is opaque and holds its shape through repeated washing. Suited to spring, cool summer days, and fall, and fits well for costumes, beach outings, or everyday wear.

specs.putting surface: approx. 2 ft x 8.5 ft inside border

record.description: A large practice putting mat with realistic premium turf designed to feel and roll like a real putting green. The mat includes two holes with flags and a padded rubber base for comfort and stability. Suitable for indoor or outdoor use, it lets golfers refine their putting at home or in the yard.

A manual focus prime lens with a bright F1.2 maximum aperture for low-light and shallow depth-of-field shooting. Its 35mm focal length gives roughly a 53mm equivalent view on APS-C bodies. Designed for Canon EOS-M mirrorless cameras, it has a crescent-shaped focus ring and a compact aluminum barrel.

A set of two flameless LED candles with a flickering moving-flame effect. Waterproof construction makes them suitable for indoor or outdoor use. A remote controls the light mode, brightness, and automatic on/off timers, and the frosted ivory shell glows more clearly when lit.

specs.type: Functional thermal underwear base layer set

record.description: A men's thermal base layer set with a long sleeve shirt and long johns, designed for cold-weather activity. Its stretchy, double-seamless fabric aims to retain warmth while wicking moisture and allowing breathability and freedom of movement for mountaineering, skiing, cycling, hiking and training.

Replacement USB charging cable for Mini S530 wireless Bluetooth earbuds and headphones. Features a 2.0mm by 12.0mm DC tip and a 30cm cable. Charges from wall adapters, laptop USB ports, power banks, and car chargers. Measure your charging port before ordering to confirm the plug fits.
A fabric storage box for organizing toys and kids' items on cube shelving. Its front tab makes it easy for children and adults to pull out, and a felt animal appliqué adds a playful touch.

A roomy grey insulated lunch bag with a double-layer design that keeps different foods separated. Its leakproof PEVA liner wipes clean easily, and the insulated lining helps keep food and drinks cold or warm. Lightweight and wide-mouthed, it works for work lunches, picnics, beach trips, or as an everyday tote.

A set of four stoneware rice bowls from Denby's Heritage Terrace line, suited to serving rice, soups, or side dishes. Handcrafted in England, they can go in the oven, microwave, freezer, and dishwasher.

A cardboard cat scratcher shaped as a chaise that doubles as a floor scratcher and a lounge. Catnip is infused between each layer so its scent is released as cats scratch. The corrugated texture resembles tree bark, which many cats prefer for scratching.
A sleeveless midi dress in navy lace with a fitted bodice and flared skirt. Partially lined for comfort and structure. The contemporary cut runs small, so consider sizing up if between sizes.
A gentle cherry blossom bath and shower gel that cleanses the skin while leaving a delicate floral fragrance. Lathers well on wet skin and rinses clean, suited to sensitive skin.

specs.package dimensions: 3.12 in L x 3.12 in W x 5.06 in H

record.description: A replacement oil filter for automotive engines, designed to help keep engine oil clean. This WIX model 57502XP is made in China and ships in a compact package weighing about three-quarters of a pound.

specs.features: Waterproof, sand-resistant, quick drying, 4 pockets, 4 ground stakes

record.description: A large, lightweight outdoor blanket that fits four to eight adults for beach, picnic, camping or hiking trips. Made of breathable nylon, it sheds sand and dries quickly. Built-in pockets hold small valuables, and four stakes keep it anchored in wind. It folds into a compact bag for easy carrying.

A boat shoe built for kids who prefer casual footwear that can pass for dressy. It has a leather-like upper, a lace-up closure with a 360-degree lacing system for a snug fit, and a cushioned memory foam footbed. The rubber outsole provides traction.

record.description: A 2-seat convertible loveseat with foldable armrests that open into a sleeper bed. The backrest adjusts across five angles for reading or lounging. It has a hardwood frame, solid wood legs, and a removable linen cover, and suits apartments, studios, and small living spaces.

specs.care: Machine washable

record.description: A men's t-shirt in burgundy with a geisha flower garden design. Made from 100% cotton for a soft feel, it is machine washable and has a tagless neck label for comfort.

specs.material details: Soft fabric wings with self-stick tabs

record.description: A Buzz Lightyear costume for toddlers, designed for Halloween dress-up. The set includes a full bodysuit, detachable soft fabric wings, gloves, and a hat. A set of three reusable stainless steel straws for drinking yerba mate, tea, and cold drinks. The flared base has small slots that let liquid through while holding back loose leaves. specs.use: Indoor plant planter or storage basket

record.description: A pair of hand-woven cotton rope baskets in two sizes, suited to hold indoor plants or to organize small household items like toys, towels, and crafts. Its natural, minimal look fits a wide range of decor styles.

A men's dress watch from Bulova with a stainless steel case and a black leather-alligator strap. It has a tonneau-shaped case, a curved mineral crystal, and an analog-quartz movement. specs.features: Open top, built-in handles
specs.care: Hand wash with soap and water; not dishwasher safe

specs.care: Machine wash cold, gentle cycle, no bleach, low iron

record.description: A pair of chenille throw pillow covers in cream with mixed black accents, sized 18 by 18 inches. Soft, textured polyester fabric suits sofas, beds, and chairs. A matching invisible zipper keeps the look clean and makes changing covers easy. Pillow inserts are sold separately.

specs.filling: All-natural grain and dried French lavender
specs.safety: Meets U.S. safety standards for all ages

specs.safety certifications: GREENGUARD Gold, CPSIA, CA-117, ASTM F963
specs.care: Wipe clean with mild soap and water or bleach-free cleaning wipe

specs.dimensions: 18 in H x 13 in W x 9 in D

record.description: A lightweight, water-repellent backpack suited to travel, hiking, camping, and everyday use. It has a padded laptop compartment, multiple exterior and interior pockets, a trolley sleeve for luggage, and a ventilated shoe compartment in the base. Wipes clean easily.

A slim, lightweight protective case built for the iPhone 11 Pro Max. Its flexible TPU shell keeps the phone's original curves while adding little bulk, and its matte surface offers a smooth, comfortable grip. Cutouts line up with the buttons, camera, flash, speakers and Lightning port.

specs.details: Ribbing at collar, cuffs and hem

record.description: A lightweight long-sleeve sweater for women in a classic, close-but-comfortable fit that allows easy movement. Made from soft, light yarn, it has a crew neckline and ribbed trim at the collar, cuffs and hem.

specs.active ingredient: Iodine 250 mcg from sea kelp (Ascophyllum nodosum)
specs.dietary notes: GMO free, soy free, gluten free

record.description: A vegetarian iodine supplement made from dried sea kelp, providing 250 mcg of iodine per capsule. The kelp is grown in the USA and encapsulated without preservatives, stearates, or artificial ingredients. Each 60-capsule bottle is a two-month supply for adults.

specs.dimensions: 20 x 14 x 7 inch (50 x 35 x 18 cm)

record.description: A carry-on travel backpack with an expandable main compartment for weekend or business trips. It has hideaway shoulder straps, multiple handles, a luggage strap for rolling over a suitcase handle, padded laptop sleeve, and an anti-theft back pocket for valuables.

Opaque acrylic paint in a 75 ml tube, in a deep Mars Black shade. It blends smoothly and dries to a waterproof finish. The tube is non-toxic and meets ASTM D 4236 safety labeling standards. Made in India.

A long striped Santa hat for Christmas festivities, with red and white stripes, trimmed faux fur, and a pom-pom topper. Made from soft felt and faux fur for comfortable wear. Sized to fit most teens and adults.

A 28-inch rose gold upright suitcase made of ABS with eight multi-directional spinner wheels for easy maneuvering. It expands by an extra two inches and includes zippered organizer pockets, elastic shoe pockets, and a garment restraint panel. A retractable trolley handle and corner guards add convenience and protection.

specs.features: Left chest pocket, taped neck and shoulder seams

record.description: A two-pack of short-sleeve men's t-shirts in white, sized extra large. Made from pre-shrunk cotton, each shirt has a left chest pocket with a small Dickies logo, a tagless back neck label, and taped neck and shoulder seams.

A classic European-style vanity stool with a padded, cushioned seat and slightly flared solid wood legs featuring carved detailing. Built on a sturdy MDF frame, it is suited to dressing tables and can also serve as a dining, lounge, piano, or shoe stool.

A navy kitchen island with a solid wood butcher block top suited to food prep or extra serving space. Two smooth-glide drawers and three cabinets offer storage, and included casters or feet let you use it as a movable cart or a stationary island. Brushed nickel hardware completes the look.

specs.surfaces: Plastic, wood, stone, metal, glass, paper

record.description: A set of 60 permanent markers in assorted bright colors with a fine point for detailed drawing, writing, coloring, and doodling. Men's Golden Goose Superstar sneakers in grey with a mix of suede-style upper and smooth blue leather heel tab and star detail. A men's slip-on sneaker from Quiksilver with a no-sew mesh upper. Welded construction and molded structural underlays are intended to give a supportive, performance-oriented fit. Finished in grey and white.

A white marine digital media receiver with built-in Bluetooth for wireless audio streaming. Its IPx5 water-resistant design suits boat use. A front USB port plays music from iOS and media devices, and it supports several common audio formats. Compatible with SiriusXM satellite radio.

A bare-board switching power supply module that converts AC 100-240V mains input into a regulated 24V DC output rated around 150W. Built on a double-sided PCB with over-voltage, over-current and short-circuit protection, it is intended for powering industrial control systems.

A modern ombre area rug from SAFAVIEH's Adirondack collection, machine-woven from synthetic fibers that resist stains and shed very little. Its low pile suits busy rooms such as living rooms, bedrooms, dining rooms and home offices, and it is practical for households with kids or pets. Vacuum regularly and blot minor spills with mild detergent.

specs.care: Stain and fade resistant

record.description: A soft black faux fur throw with a plush front and fluffy sherpa back, offering warmth for couches, beds, and chairs. Its understated tie-dye pattern adds a stylish accent to living spaces. Made from microfiber, it is reversible, skin-friendly, and suited to sensitive skin.
A women's slide sandal from Ted Baker in a bright yellow shade. The Avelini style offers an easy, slip-on design for warm-weather wear. Available in US women's size 8.5 Regular.

A decorative throw pillow featuring a campfire scene with white lettering joking that camping without beer is just sitting in the woods. Double-sided print with a soft polyester fill, sewn closed. A fun gift for camping enthusiasts and couples who enjoy the campsite.

Six-pair pack of men's no-show socks from adidas in a lightweight Superlite construction. Moisture-wicking yarn helps keep feet dry from sweat. A large adidas wordmark is knit on the outside of the foot. Sized Large for shoe sizes 6 to 12.

specs.closure: Elastic ankle strap with heel zipper

record.description: Minimalist black ballet flats with a soft faux suede upper and elastic ankle strap. A heel zipper makes them easy to slip on and off. Cushioned, contoured soles and a gripping outsole suit everyday walking, errands, and casual or semi-formal outfits.

specs.frame: Pine wood bar, ready to hang

record.description: Framed floral canvas wall art featuring a simple, elegant blossom design in gray and yellow tones. Giclee-printed on waterproof archival canvas and stretched over a pine frame, it is ready to hang and suits living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, offices, and other spaces.

A full figure underwire bra with lace construction and two-part seamed full coverage cups meant to offer lift, shape, and support. Sheer mesh panels sit at the top of the cups, while a smooth band and sides help reduce bulge. Finished with a leotard back.

Individual eyelash extensions in a hybrid silk and mink blend, offered in several L-series curls and a range of thicknesses and lengths. The lashes are described as soft and dark, and they lift from the strip cleanly without residue or kinking.

A lightweight infant lounger that folds into a backpack in one motion for easy carrying. It includes a removable activity bar and canopy, has a waterproof base, and its cover can be machine washed. Suitable for use both indoors and outdoors.

specs.construction: Triple layer: hard PC shell with soft silicone inner skin

specs.features: Attached dust caps for charging port

record.description: A slim yellow protective case for the iPod Touch 5th, 6th and 7th generation. It pairs a hard outer shell with a soft silicone inner layer to absorb shocks from small drops, while a raised edge helps guard the screen and camera. Cutouts give access to buttons and ports, and dust caps cover the charging port.

specs.care: Hand wash only; not dishwasher safe

record.description: A refillable pump dispenser for liquid hand soap, dish soap, hand sanitizer, or essential oils. Its compact round frosted body suits bathroom vanities, small pedestal sinks, and kitchen sinks. The removable pump head and wide mouth make refilling simple, and the plastic resists rust in humid bathrooms.

specs.coverage: Up to 500 sq. ft. per kit, depending on surface porosity
specs.cure time: Walk on in 8-10 hours, vehicle ready in 24 hours

record.description: A self-leveling, buildable polycuramine coating for interior concrete floors such as garages, workshops, and basements. specs.battery life: About a month or more per charge

specs.feature: Force Touch with four force sensors

record.description: A wireless, rechargeable trackpad for Mac that adds Force Touch to the desktop. Click anywhere on its larger glass surface and register differences in pressure. Its low profile suits comfortable scrolling and swiping, and it pairs automatically with a Mac.

Bodhi Spirit vetiver incense sticks offer a light, earthy woodsy fragrance made from natural herbs, resins, woods and oils. A set of 68 eleven-inch sticks suited to meditation, yoga, worship and creating a calm atmosphere at home.

specs.material: Dotted mesh cups with stretch lace trim

record.description: An unlined women's bralette with dotted mesh cups and stretch lace trim at the cups, underarm, and underband. Adjustable double rouleau elastic straps and rose gold tone hardware complete the design. Available in size L in the Black Caviar colorway.

specs.features: Removable oven stone, preheating function
specs.suitable_for: Frozen, pre-baked, or fresh dough pizzas

record.description: A red countertop pizza oven that handles frozen, pre-baked, or fresh dough pizzas. Its removable stone helps bake crusts evenly and crisp. Upper and lower heating elements, a preheating function, and variable temperature control up to about 680 degrees F give you flexible baking.

A women's winter ski jacket that works as a three-in-one system: wear the waterproof shell alone for rain, the insulating liner alone for warmth, or both layers together in cold weather. It has a detachable hood, elastic cuffs, and zip-secured pockets for essentials.

specs.trim: White marabou trim on the sides
specs.feathers: Large black, white, and blue faux feathers

record.description: A deluxe feather headdress for Halloween costumes and themed parties. It features large faux feathers in black, white, and blue with white marabou trim on the sides. One size fits most teens and adults, making it a fitting accessory for role play or to complement a Native American costume.

A women's automatic Rolex Datejust in reference 179178, with an 18k yellow gold case, bezel and bracelet and a silver dial. Listed in excellent condition, certified authentic, serviced as needed, and sold with a one-year warranty.

A six-pack of women's crew socks in assorted rainbow and solid colors, each pair with its own playful print. Made from combed cotton blended with spandex and polyester for softness, moisture wicking, and a snug, elastic fit. Suitable for athletic shoes, boots, or everyday casual wear.

specs.product type: 2-in-1 matte lip crayon and lip balm kit

record.description: A two-in-one lip kit pairing a buildable matte lip crayon with a built-in lip balm. The crayon offers vivid, full-coverage color with a lightweight, soft feel and a pointed tip for lining. The balm adds nourishing hydration, a subtle tint, or a glossy shine over the lipstick. Six classic shades range from nudes to bold reds.

specs.frame: Powder coated aluminum with steel rectangular ribs

record.description: A 9-foot half patio umbrella in beige for shading balconies, decks, and patio tables. It tilts with a push button to adjust sun coverage, and a crank lets you raise or lower it. A top vent helps air and heat escape. The water-resistant polyester canopy and steel ribs are built for outdoor use.

A four-pack of Mainstays 3-wick scented candles in glass jars, each with a warm Mulled Cider fragrance. Designed to scent a room while adding a simple touch of decor, they suit gatherings with family and friends. Store in a cool place for best use.

A lightweight, breathable mid-thigh shaping short from SPANX designed to smooth the lower stomach. The high-waisted cut is made from microfiber with a cotton gusset, aiming to reduce visible panty lines without needing underwear beneath.

specs.type: Girls' racerback seamless crop cami bralette
specs.care: Machine wash cool, tumble dry low

record.description: A lightweight, stretchy starter bralette for girls, sold as a four-pack of seamless racerback styles with removable pads. The tag-free, smooth design is made to feel comfortable on sensitive skin and suits everyday wear and active days.

Women's 6-inch work boot built on a women's last for a comfortable fit. Features full-grain leather with a waterproof membrane, an alloy safety toe, and an all-weather TPU outsole. Includes anti-fatigue footbed technology for all-day wear on job sites.

specs.lens coating: HDC multicoating and AquaDura on outer lenses

record.description: A compact 10x25 binocular with a rubber-armored, waterproof housing rated to 5 meters. Its central focus knob allows quick, precise adjustment, and its multicoated lenses with AquaDura outer coating resist water, dirt, and scratches.

specs.features: Adjustable landscape stand, built-in S Pen holder

record.description: A slim protective case with a detachable Bluetooth keyboard for the Galaxy Tab S4 10.5 (2018). The keyboard has spring-backed keys for a firm, tactile feel, a backlight with multiple brightness and color settings, and an adjustable stand for landscape viewing. A slot holds an S Pen, though the pen is sold separately.

A set of 100 wide-mouthed disposable plastic straws in assorted bright colors. Each straw is about 8.2 inches long with a 0.43-inch opening, sized for thick drinks like smoothies, milkshakes, and bubble tea. Smooth ends, suitable for single use or washing and reuse, and handy for crafts and party tables.

A lace-up rock climbing and bouldering shoe for women, built with a leather upper that offers some stretch and breathability. The smooth shoe last suits long sessions, and reinforced edge protection on the front upper helps keep the shoe's shape. Designed for a higher instep, narrower foot shape, suiting women and men with narrower feet.

specs.pockets: 2 pockets with interior die-cut business card holder
specs.capacity: Holds up to 100 sheets (50 per pocket)

record.description: A box of 25 green letter-size folders with a glossy laminated finish. Each folder has two pockets and an interior business card holder, making it suited to presentations, school projects, or client leave-behinds. The laminated surface resists tearing better than standard paper folders.

Warm convertible mittens that flip open with magnets into fingerless gloves, so your fingers stay free for fishing, photography, or texting. Insulated with Thinsulate and fleece, with a windproof membrane, silicone palm grips, and reflective strips for low-light visibility. Suited to cold-weather outdoor activities but not extreme cold or heavy snow.

specs.pockets: Two button-through welt pockets at rear

record.description: Men's slim-fit dress pants with a flat front and a tapered leg that is fitted through the hip and thigh. Made from smooth, flexible polyester twill for comfortable movement. Sits below the waist and includes two rear welt pockets with button closures.

specs.care: Machine wash up to 30°C/86°F

record.description: A lightweight women's hooded jacket with a faux sheepskin lining for softness and warmth. The fixed hood is lined in echo-lamb, and the jacket resists wind and rain. It has a double-slider zip with a personalized puller and two pockets with invisible zips. It packs into its own pouch for easy carrying.

specs.care: Machine wash, tumble dry

record.description: A six-pair set of baby crew socks for year-round wear, mixing cooling mesh pairs with warmer waffle-knit thermal pairs. Cushioned soles add comfort, and non-skid grippers help reduce slipping. Machine washable and dryer safe.

A sheer organza ribbon with wired edges that holds shape well for bows, wreaths, and floral arrangements. The base has a subtle sheen and is described as waterproof, suiting outdoor holiday decor and wet floral work. Sold as a 25-yard spool in a bright red shade.

specs.material: 304 stainless steel strap, zinc-plated bolt and nut

Requires straight pipe run on both sides of the joint.

A large cotton canvas sheet for covering floors, carpets, and furniture during painting or dusty work, indoors or outdoors. It soaks up paint spills and traps dust and debris. The heavy fabric can be machine washed for repeated use, and its double-stitched edges resist fraying.

Disposable clear plastic martini glasses with stems, designed to give desserts, appetizers, mousse, and drinks an elegant look. Each cup comes as a two-piece cup and base set. Suitable for weddings, birthday parties, and other events. Clean-up is simple, or the cups can be washed and reused.

Field marking paint designed for line striping athletic fields. Formulated to be used in an inverted position with aerosol marking machines, and its universal tip fits most marking machines. Dries quickly and covers in a single coat.
Rectangular full-rim sunglasses from Gucci in a dark havana frame with gold accents. Green silver mirror lenses offer 100% UV protection. Non-polarized, sized for a 57 mm lens width.
A travel-sized women's eau de parfum spray from Versace's Eros Pour Femme line. The 0.17 ounce bottle makes it easy to carry or sample the fragrance before committing to a larger size.

specs.features: Water resistant, Heatseal warmth, dual zipper, secure hand pockets

record.description: A lightweight women's winter jacket from Columbia in black, filled with 650-fill down for warmth. It has a hood, a water-resistant shell, secure hand pockets, and a dual zipper for easy opening and closing.

A compact Baoer LF606 mini quadcopter with altitude hold, GPS tracking, and a return-to-home function. It features a foldable body, replaceable arms, and headless mode, and it is sold without a camera. Suited to beginner flyers and as a gift for kids or adults.

Reusable silicone ear plugs for sleeping, snoring, and hearing protection. Three pairs in small, medium, and large sizes help you find a comfortable fit. Oval shape with ear hooks keeps them in place overnight, and they are washable for repeated use.

A high rise, A-line maxi denim skirt in light blue, sized XL. It has a curved waist, functional front and back pockets, and contrast stitching. A 35 inch length and a button and zipper closure give it a classic look suited to work, school, or casual outings.

Mid-rise 7/8 length performance leggings for women with a flat, wide waistband and flatlock stitching for comfort and freedom of movement. Black with blue side stripes, suited to training and everyday active wear.

An oval tin wall sign from Harley-Davidson featuring an embossed, die-cut Bar & Shield logo and script lettering. Measuring 18 by 10.5 inches, it has holes for easy hanging and suits a garage, shop, or other room. A fitting gift for fans of the brand.

specs.power: One power per pack, not mixed

record.description: A four-pack of oversized square reading glasses for women, with spring hinges and a frame height of about 47 mm. A slim, lightweight soft silicone case for the Apple iPhone 7 Plus and iPhone 8 Plus, featuring a smoke-tinted skeleton design. Cutouts leave the audio jack, charging port, and volume buttons accessible. The case is easy to remove and helps guard against scratches and minor bumps.
An eight-skein pack of multi-colored six-strand cotton embroidery floss with an over-dyed effect. Each skein holds 8.7 yards, suited to cross-stitch and other needlework projects.

An 85-inch 4K UHD smart TV with quantum dot QLED display and Quantum HDR for wide color range and contrast. Dual LED backlights adjust in real time, and an AI-based processor upscales lower-resolution content to 4K. Alexa is built in, and the slim design suits modern rooms.

A couple's promise ring with a round inlaid cubic zirconia set in white gold tone. The A-OO-A-Z design is meant to symbolize love and commitment. Suitable as a gift for anniversaries, Valentine's Day, or weddings. Keep it boxed and away from water, perfume, and chemicals to prevent tarnishing.

A long sleeve fishing shirt from Columbia's PFG line, made of quick-drying polyester interlock. It blocks UVA and UVB rays and moves moisture away from the skin to help keep you cool. Its classic fit and colorful tribal fish graphic suit time on the water or around a campfire.

specs.features: Moisture wicking, tag free, double needle hem

record.description: A five-pack of men's undershirts in grey and black, sized X-Large. The solid shirts are 100% cotton, and the sport grey shirts blend cotton with polyester. Moisture-wicking fabric helps keep you cool and dry, and the tag-free design with a double needle hem adds comfort.

A men's smartwatch from Timex with a white dial, green hour markers, and a silver-tone brass case. It tracks steps, distance, calories, and sleep, and syncs with a phone over Bluetooth. Includes an Indiglo backlight and an adjustable black leather strap.

Lightweight kids' running shoe in black and white with a BOA dial closure for a quick, adjustable fit without laces. A breathable synthetic and mesh upper keeps feet comfortable, while the REVlite midsole adds light cushioning and the rubber outsole provides grip and durability.

specs.care: Machine wash with like colors, tumble dry low, no iron

specs.type: Gaming chair with massage lumbar cushion
specs.features: 360-degree swivel, rocking, height-adjustable seat and armrests

A royal blue ball gown in sequined tulle, suited to quinceanera, prom, and formal evening events. It features a sweetheart neckline, sleeveless bodice, and 3D floral and pearl embellishments, with a floor-length skirt and lace-up corset back. Made to order.

specs.care: Machine washable, pre-shrunk

record.description: A short-sleeve orange t-shirt with a Tampa Bay football fan graphic. Made from 100% cotton, pre-shrunk, and screen printed in the USA. Machine washable for easy everyday wear.

A wireless presentation clicker with a built-in laser pointer that works over Bluetooth or a small USB receiver stored in its dock. A chrome replacement tub spout for Delta faucets with a pull-out diverter for a hand shower. It fits 1/2 inch or 3/4 inch standard pipe and is made to original specifications and tested for reliable performance.

specs.item type: Mechanical pencil and ballpoint pen set

record.description: A two-piece writing set with a stainless steel mechanical pencil and ballpoint pen in silver. The pencil takes 0.7mm HB lead and the pen uses 0.8mm black ink. Knurled grips aid control, and the soft, quiet retraction plunger suits focused writing.

record.description: A quilted heated mattress pad in white, sized for a king bed. Dual side controllers each offer 10 heat settings and an auto-off function. Dual-sided heating aims to keep warmth consistent overnight, and the soft polyester surface can be machine washed and dried.

A trunk-mounted rack that carries three bicycles on sedans, hatchbacks, minivans, and many SUVs. Individual tie-downs secure each bike, and side straps add lateral stability. A floor-length maxi dress in burgundy with an off-the-shoulder neckline, layered ruffles, and a ruched empire waist. A men's quartz wristwatch with a wooden case and stainless steel bracelet, offering a casual look suited to everyday or business wear. Features an engraveable back for a personalized gift, and comes with a bamboo watch box.

A double-sided makeup mirror with a regular side and a 10X magnifying side for close detail work. The 5.8-inch optical glass surface gives a clear, wide view, and the mirror rotates 360 degrees so it can be fixed at any angle. Its light frame suits both tabletop placement and handheld use.

record.description: A carrying bundle for the Cricut Joy machine, with a padded tote, a weeder, spatula and scraper, fine-point pens, a replacement blade, and a digital beginner guide to Cricut smart materials. Designed for crafting on the go.

A dainty gold evil eye necklace with a hammered-finish pendant and a sparkling cubic zirconia accent on a delicate chain. Plated over brass and free of lead and nickel, it suits everyday wear, parties, and gifting. Includes a 2-inch extension for adjustable length and comes in a gift box.

A hand-carved pink Himalayan salt lamp with a unique shape, set on a natural neem wood base. The integrated dimmer adjusts the warm orange glow for daytime or nighttime use. Arrives fully assembled in a gift box with a spare bulb.
