specs.material: Fiber-reinforced polycarbonate with stainless steel hardware
specs.compatibility: Mounts two lights or flashes, works with grips and Flex Arms

record.description: A dual-tray camera accessory for underwater photography that holds two lights or flashes at once to boost brightness, reduce shadows, and steady the rig. It attaches to any camera with a standard 1/4-20 tripod mount and includes a mounting knob. Accessories snap on and off quickly.

A single clear acrylic taper ear plug for stretched lobes, measuring 12mm (1/2 inch). Pink glitter heart confetti is suspended within the acrylic. Two rubber O-rings are included. Sold individually, so buy two for a matching pair.

specs.material: E1 standard wood panel, metal frame

record.description: A spacious 63-inch writing desk with a simple square top, suited to a home office, workstation, or small meeting table. The wood panel has a waterproof, scratch-resistant surface that wipes clean easily, and a sturdy metal frame with adjustable legs helps it sit level on uneven floors. Meets BIFMA standards and assembles in about ten minutes.

specs.use: Display in kitchen, dining room, curio cabinet, or shelf

record.description: A set of six clear display easels that each hold one teacup with its saucer standing behind, so both pieces stay visible. Suited to showing off collectible dishware in a kitchen, dining room, curio cabinet, or on a shelf. A thoughtful gift for a dishware collector.

A set of eight pairs of graduated compression socks for women and men, rated 15-20 mmHg. Designed to support circulation during long days, travel, exercise, and recovery. The nylon-rich blend is breathable and moisture absorbent, with seams placed away from areas that rub.

specs.material: Solid polished brass with wood handle

record.description: A large vintage-style school bell with a solid polished brass body and a wooden handle. It works as a functional hand bell and as a decorative piece, measuring about 12 inches high and 5.5 inches long.

A long sleeve fishing tee from Columbia's PFG line, made from quick-drying polyester interlock. Built-in UPF 50 sun protection and moisture-wicking fabric help keep the wearer cool and dry on the water. Cut for a classic, comfortable fit.

A pack of ten black gel ink pens with a fine 0.38 mm tip for smooth, consistent writing. The pigment-based ink is waterproof and fade-resistant, suited to everyday notes, calendar entries, and detailed work.

specs.material: 300GSM cardboard, plastic window, natural jute twine

record.description: Fourteen black bakery boxes with a clear window, sized for cupcakes, macarons, and cookies. Made from sturdy cardboard, they fold together quickly and include a jute twine for wrapping and carrying. A large blank surface offers room for custom decoration, suiting party favors and celebrations.

specs.style: Bib overall shorts with raw hem

record.description: Casual women's denim bib overall shorts with a distressed, ripped design and raw cuffed hem. Adjustable straps with metal buckles and four pockets offer a practical fit. Lightweight, soft, and breathable with some stretch, suited to everyday wear, summer outings, and travel.

Sterling silver stud earrings with rhodium plating, set with princess-cut cubic zirconia and a cushion-shaped halo. The sparkling white stones offer a diamond-like look for everyday wear or special occasions. Comes with a drawstring jewelry pouch, suitable for gifting or storage.

A downloadable will kit with forms and instructions for drafting a legally valid will. It helps you allocate assets, name beneficiaries, and appoint a guardian for minor children. Product registration is required to access the state-specific forms.

specs.package: Cloth carrying pouch and gift box

record.description: A set of four wooden vehicle jigsaw puzzles for toddlers aged one to three. Each features a steamer, airplane, car, or police car in bright colors. Thick, smooth-edged pieces are easy for small hands to grip, supporting hand-eye coordination and early color and shape recognition. Comes packed in a drawstring pouch, suitable for home or outdoor play.

A modern semi-flush ceiling fan with an LED light that offers three color temperatures and stepless dimming. It has three fan speeds and a sleep mode with soft warm white night light. The low-profile design with a white lampshade and black shell suits living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens and studies.

A modern flush mount ceiling light with a chrome metal dome and a shade of 143 K9 crystal balls that sparkle whether the light is on or off. Suited to entryways, hallways, dining rooms, and bedrooms. Compatible with dimmable E26 bulbs; LED bulbs are recommended for longer life.

A halo engagement ring with a round clear cubic zirconia center stone surrounded by micro-pave stones, which also run along the band. Made of rhodium-plated sterling silver, it is nickel free and suited to sensitive skin. Size 7 and presented in a leather box, it works for engagements, weddings, or anniversaries.

specs.compatibility: iPhone 11, iPhone 11 Pro, iPhone 11 Pro Max
specs.card slots: 3 card slots and a cash slot
specs.features: Built-in stand, precise cutouts for ports, camera and buttons
specs.design: Japanese anime One Piece Sabo print

record.description: A slim wallet-style case for iPhone 11, 11 Pro and 11 Pro Max that holds three cards and some cash alongside your phone. Its soft inner shell and shock-absorbing edges help guard against drops and scratches, and the stand offers viewing angles for video or calls.

A nylon window seal that closes the side gaps of an open casement window so a portable air conditioner's exhaust hose can pass through with a zipper. It blocks warm air from flowing back into the room, helping the unit cool more efficiently. Attaches with adhesive hook tape, needs no drilling, and removes without residue when not in use.

specs.material: Absorbent polyester fabric with waterproof backing
specs.care: Machine washable; do not bleach

record.description: A low-profile dish drying mat that soaks up water and keeps countertops dry. Its waterproof, slip-resistant backing stops spills from reaching the surface below and holds the mat in place. Suited to drying dishes, glasses, silverware, pots, and produce. The edges can be trimmed with scissors without fraying, and the mat can be machine washed.

Backup solar charging battery for Suntek hunting and trail cameras, mounted by strap or tripod. It includes overload and overdischarge protection, a weatherproof IP 65 housing, and a compact, lightweight build suited to outdoor use.

Men's mesh athletic shorts built for airflow during workouts. Dri-Power moisture-wicking fabric helps keep you dry, while the elastic waistband with internal draw cord allows an adjustable fit. Side pockets hold small essentials, and the 9-inch inseam offers a comfortable length.

A slim-fitting long-sleeve ribbed knit pullover with a cross-wrap asymmetrical neckline and plain solid styling. Stretchy fabric suits casual or going-out looks, pairing easily with pants, shorts, skirts, or jeans. Runs small, so check the size chart, especially bust measurement.

specs.light feature: LEDs light up as wheels turn, no batteries

record.description: Clip-on heel wheels that turn ordinary shoes into roller skates for kids. The wheels light up with a neon glow as they spin, without batteries. They adjust to fit different shoes and include a rubber strap and larger brakes for stopping.

Thin white matte tape for drawing straight, even lines on charts, crafts, decorations, and signage. Its permanent adhesive holds up indoors and outdoors on clean, dry surfaces such as plastic, glass, paper, wood, metal, and ceramic.

specs.assembled dimensions: 54.53 L x 29.92 W x 18.90 H inches

record.description: A wooden toddler bed with a PAW Patrol Nick Jr. theme, made for children from 15 months up. Two high side rails help keep little sleepers safe during the move to a big kid bed. Assembly is straightforward, and the bed is JPMA certified to meet CPSC and ASTM safety standards.

specs.care: Machine wash cold, gentle cycle; tumble dry; cool iron if needed; do not bleach

record.description: A pair of solid ivory sheer curtain panels with a textured linen-look finish. Each panel has eight silver grommets for easy hanging on a rod. The fabric lets in soft natural light while blocking strong midday sun and offering some privacy, suiting bedrooms, living rooms and other spaces.

specs.included: 2 magnets, 1 black marker with built-in eraser

record.description: A small magnetic dry erase whiteboard with a lightweight aluminum frame and a clean, minimal look. Use it for reminders, lists, dates, or drawings, or pin photos and notes to its magnetic surface. Includes a marker with eraser, two magnets, and mounting hardware for hanging it horizontally or vertically.

specs.contents: 5 sandwich bags, 5 snack bags, 2 large storage bags
specs.closure: Zip lock seal with 2 sealing clips

record.description: A 12-piece set of reusable zip-top bags made from food-grade PEVA plastic free of BPA, PVC, and lead. Transparent bags suit sandwiches, snacks, fruit, and freezer storage. They are not for microwave, oven, or dishwasher use, and should be hand washed and air dried.
A seven-piece set of long-sleeve bodysuits for baby girls in an assorted pack. Each one features strong snaps designed to hold up through frequent washing and everyday wear. Sized for 18 months.

specs.key ingredients: Amla fruit extract, white tea extract, hyaluronic acid

record.description: A vanilla-flavored vegan protein powder designed to support the body's own collagen production. It blends plant proteins, amino acids, and botanical extracts, and can be mixed into shakes, smoothies, or coffee. Free of dairy, gluten, soy, and common allergens.

Six refill bulbs for Wallflower fragrance plugs and night-lights, offering a warm blend of spicy pumpkin, sweet butter, and vanilla cream. The scent is noted to be discontinued and may be hard to find.

specs.origin: Eastern Europe (Russia, Romania, Croatia, Serbia, Ukraine, and others)
specs.contents: Candy, cookies, chocolates, wafers, biscuits, pretzels

record.description: A mixed box of packaged snacks made in Eastern European countries. Each box holds a varying selection of candy, cookies, chocolates, wafers, biscuits, and pretzels, with at least eight items. Contents differ from box to box, so the photos show only examples.

specs.fitment: Universal manual and automatic vehicles without shift button
specs.package: 1 shifter knob, 3 adapters, 1 hex spanner, 4 screws

record.description: A black skull-design gear shift knob made from resin with an aluminum alloy base. It includes three rubber adapters so it can fit shift levers of different diameters. Intended for manual and automatic cars without a shift button, it is installed with a small hex spanner and screws. Not suitable for reverse-pull shifters or shifters with buttons.

specs.included: 6 packets of water gels for floating

record.description: Ivory faux pearls with a polished finish and no drilled holes, offering a smooth look. Sized in three diameters, they work as table scatter or vase fillers for weddings, showers, and other celebrations. Includes six packets of transparent water gels that help the pearls float in water. Reusable for multiple events.

specs.includes: Modes Bassinet Stroller and SnugRide SnugLock 35 Infant Car Seat
specs.stroller modes: 3 in 1 (bassinet, infant car seat carrier, toddler stroller)
specs.seat pad cleaning: Spot clean with mild soap and warm water

record.description: A travel system bundling a bassinet-style stroller with an infant car seat. The stroller converts from bassinet to infant carrier to toddler seat, offering nine riding options from newborn through toddler years. The car seat clicks directly onto the stroller frame for quick setup.

specs.included: Tray only; flower box not included

record.description: A white plastic tray sized to hold a 24-inch flower box and protect decks, patios, or indoor surfaces from water and soil. Lightweight and fade-resistant, it is made in the USA. Only the tray is included.

specs.material: Steel with rust resistant plastic coat
specs.dimensions: 10.25 x 16 x 5.5 inches (L x W x H)
specs.fit: Snug fit arms for cabinet shelves

record.description: A medium light blue wire basket that attaches under a cabinet shelf to create a second storage level. Its steel frame has a rust resistant plastic coating and holds items such as spices, napkins, and small kitchen goods. Snug fit arms let it sit on standard shelves, and it can also be used in pantries or on desks.

A small heart-shaped locket that opens to hold up to two photos, finished in 24k gold plate for a warm, polished look. Sold with or without an 18-inch curb chain, it arrives in a black velvet pouch for easy gifting. The maker offers a lifetime replacement guarantee on the piece.
A pocket-sized brass fountain pen from Kaweco with a fine gold-plated steel nib. Lightweight at 21 grams, it writes smoothly and is hand-produced with individual quality checks in Nuremberg.

specs.material: Lash extensions with special root glue strip

record.description: Self-fanning volume lash extensions designed for lash technicians new to the volume technique. A sticky base strip helps keep fans together so they can be formed quickly. Available in a 0.07mm thickness and 14-20mm mixed lengths, in a blue shade.

A wall-mounted coat rack with five metal hooks for hanging coats, hats, bags, and umbrellas. Its weathered white distressed wood finish adds rustic character to entryways, kitchens, and bedrooms. Mounting hardware is included, and the rack holds up to 30 pounds to help keep clutter off the floor.

specs.load capacity: 200 pounds or more when installed properly
specs.compatible items: Fishing and hunting waders, wader boots

record.description: A stainless steel hanger for drying and storing fishing or hunting waders and wader boots. Its heavy-duty chain helps waders keep their shape and keeps boots off the ground, whether hung in a closet or from a tree branch.

specs.construction: Bonded fleece with grid knit texture

record.description: A men's full-zip jacket with a grid-knit fleece exterior and a soft Sherpa lining for warmth. It has an embroidered logo on the front, two side zip pockets, and works as a layer under a shell in cold weather.

specs.dimensions: 23 in high x 16 in wide x 25 in long

record.description: A pet stair that helps dogs reach couches and higher beds with ease. Its gentle incline on each step means fewer steps to climb. Suitable for small, medium, and large dogs, it has a carpet tread that comes off for simple cleaning.

specs.functions: Black and red ballpoint, 0.5mm pencil, stylus, eraser

record.description: A slim multifunction pen with a satin black finish and chrome accents. A twist switches between black ballpoint, red ballpoint, and pencil, and the cap holds a stylus and an eraser. Personalized engraving is available. Suited to students, editors, and note-takers.

specs.care: Machine Washable, Pre-Shrunk

record.description: A black short-sleeve football fan t-shirt with a Raiders-themed screen-printed design. Made of 100% cotton, pre-shrunk for a consistent fit, and machine washable. Sizes run from small to 5X.

specs.footbed: Soft EVA with anatomical arch support

record.description: Casual sandals for boys with a vegan leather strap lined in soft jersey for comfortable wear. The flexible EVA footbed offers arch support, and the grippy molded outsole provides traction in multiple directions.

specs.features: Mesh underarm inserts, Climalite sweat-wicking

record.description: A white Real Madrid home jersey for kids from adidas, styled with gold accents and a woven club crest. Made from recycled polyester with sweat-wicking fabric, it has a relaxed straight cut and short sleeves, designed for fans rather than players on game day.
An HDTV cable for connecting a Sega Saturn console to a high-definition television. It supports 720p resolution for clear video and crisp audio, and a 6 ft. Micro cable is included.

specs.fits: Oakley Holbrook, model numbers starting OO9102

record.description: Replacement lenses for Oakley Holbrook sunglasses with a dark silver mirror finish. The polarized lenses offer UV protection and impact resistance, and help reduce glare for daytime driving. Designed for model numbers starting with OO9102 in 55mm size. Frame not included.

specs.footbed: Molded EVA with arch support, heel cup, and toe bar

record.description: A women's thong sandal designed for beach outings and time by the water. Fabric straps sit over a soft nubuck toe post. The molded EVA footbed dries quickly and offers arch support, a heel cup, and a toe bar. A shock-absorbing midsole and flexible, slip-resistant rubber outsole round out the design.
A heavyweight dog bowl with a rubber base that grips slippery floors like tile and linoleum to reduce sliding. Sized for extra large breeds, it is dishwasher safe and comes in assorted colors.

An officially licensed LEGO Batman wall poster with a grid-style design, printed from high-resolution artwork on FSC-certified gloss paper. Unframed, it can be framed or hung with clips, push pins, or poster mounts. Suited to bedrooms, kids' rooms, parties, and other spaces.

specs.pattern: Blue stripe, orange gators, gray stripe

record.description: A three-pack of sleeveless toddler boys' tank tops in size 3T. Each tank has a ribbed neckline and a pocket detail. The set includes blue striped, orange gator-print, and gray striped styles for everyday wear.

Large double wall shipping box with a bottom-style gaylord design for consolidating multiple-piece shipments. Built from heavy kraft corrugated board to protect bulky and irregularly shaped items. Sold as a pack of 75 and shipped flat to save space.

specs.pockets: 2 main zippered compartments, 1 front zippered pocket, anti-theft interlayer
specs.features: External USB charging port, headphone hole

record.description: A compact black sling bag for men, made from water-resistant PU leather with adjustable nylon straps. It offers two main compartments, a front zippered pocket, and an anti-theft interlayer for small essentials. An external USB charging port and side headphone hole add convenience for travel, cycling, and everyday use.

specs.figure: grandmother and young girl holding hands

record.description: A hand-painted resin figurine showing an older woman in a cream dress seated on a gray bench beside a young girl in a matching dress, holding hands. Designed as a gift celebrating the bond between grandparent and child, it includes a card reading 'The best gift is time spent with you.' Ready to display on a shelf, table, or mantel.

specs.blade type: Replaceable premium wire cutters, four outside-opening blades

record.description: A heavy-duty multitool with 21 tools, including the largest pliers and longest blades in the line. Replaceable wire cutters and spring-action scissors are included. Every tool opens one-handed, and all features lock for safe use. Made in Portland, Oregon, with a lanyard ring and a nylon sheath for carrying.

specs.included: Matching chef hat with Velcro fastener
specs.fit: Select size by bust size in size chart

record.description: A short-sleeved women's chef's coat in white, cut double-breasted so it can be worn either way. It has ten buttons and comes with a matching chef hat that fastens with Velcro to fit a range of head sizes. Choose your size using the bust measurement in the size chart.

Neoprene diving gloves designed for snorkeling, kayaking, surfing and other water sports. The 3MM material keeps hands warm, the textured palm improves grip on wet items, and the velcro strap helps seal out sand and debris. Not fully waterproof; intended to pair with a wetsuit.

specs.care: Machine washable cold, tumble dry low

record.description: Casual denim shortalls for women and juniors with multiple pockets, adjustable straps, and a cuffed 3-inch inseam. The center front zipper closure makes them easy to put on, and they are machine washable.

A compact USB-C multiport hub that adds four USB 3.0 ports for keyboards, mice, flash drives and external drives. It passes through up to 60W of power to a USB Power Delivery laptop while powering connected accessories. Plug-and-play with no external drivers, in a space gray aluminum body with an LED indicator.

An official poster by artist Alex Grey, titled Oversoul. Printed to museum quality standards, it measures 18 by 24 inches and suits display in homes, studios, or offices. Its visionary imagery explores the link between human awareness and cosmic consciousness.

A foldable camp rocking chair with a powder-coated steel frame and breathable TechMesh seat. It locks into a low-profile rocking position for leaning back and relaxing. Folds compactly and comes with a shoulder bag for easy transport and storage.

specs.product: Child's Play 2 Good Guy batteries (prop accessory)

record.description: Official prop-style accessory batteries inspired by the Good Guy doll from the Child's Play 2 film. Designed to complement a Good Guy doll for collectors and fans of the movie. Two Size D batteries per pack.
